answer: Require every agent to post a costly refundable stake before it can transact, so each identity is like cracking open a walnut of locked value rather than a free throwaway. Honest reputation then accrues slowly, like a coral reef built layer by layer, and a swarm of fresh fake identities stays an isolated island no established peer will attest. Faking a thousand agents costs a thousand real bonds, which makes the sybil attack uneconomic.
